repoRoot.description: Absolute or EXE-relative path to a Hugo project containing hugo.toml and content/.

port.description: Loopback port for the LilyMap management UI.

openBrowser.description: Open the management UI after the local server is ready.

hugoPath.description: Optional absolute or project-relative Hugo executable. LilyMap otherwise uses the project's bundled Hugo and then Hugo on PATH.
